explanation_full: This chart compares how well different predictive models estimate the target value, showing that KNN performed the best with an R² score of 0.8172. The R² score measures how much of the variation in the target value is explained by the model, with higher values indicating a better fit. KNN significantly outperformed other models, such as RF (R²=0.7756) and XGBoost (R²=0.7495), suggesting it is the most reliable method for this prediction. A practical caution is that while KNN is the best, its performance relies heavily on the quality and relevance of all input features, so careful data preparation is crucial.
